verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents physical storage windows (up to 30 days for letters, 10 days for packages), includes secure shredding, and lets users forward physical items, which covers the storage and basic disposal parts of the story. Nothing shows shredding is triggered on request, that a shred confirmation is issued, or that disposal can be chosen item by item. Missing for 10: on-request shredding workflow, shred confirmation/certificate, documented per-item disposal choices (shred vs. forward vs. hold), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices

citations.quote: Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
easily forward physical items wherever you need them
